title: Slow Cooker Pulled Chicken
subtitle: BBQ pulled chicken
description: Easy shredded BBQ chicken: breasts slow-cooked with onion, barbecue sauce and a splash of broth (or beer), then pulled and sauced for sandwiches.

ingredients.note: 1 cup to cook, 1 cup to finish

steps.heading: Season
steps.text: Lay the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle it with the garlic powder, salt and pepper.

steps.heading: Add the Sauce
steps.text: Scatter the onion over the chicken, then pour on 1 cup of the barbecue sauce and the broth or beer.

steps.heading: Slow Cook
steps.text: Cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours (or high 3 to 4) until the chicken shreds easily.

steps.heading: Shred
steps.text: Take out the chicken, pull it apart with two forks and spoon some of the cooking juices over it.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Toss with the remaining cup of barbecue sauce and pile onto buns, with coleslaw if you like.
